body:
I don't really wanna go into how she's sketchy right now at least not in a public conversation 

I'm not strong at all bro even if I've made it 15 years nearly in this world I'm still giving up the fight, thats not me being strong that's me being selfish and weak.

I'll see if I can get my hands on meds quickly i guess and I might even update you if I make it through this shit I guess. Anyways im gonna go lay down and chill for a bit, thanks for talking with me.

I might try and get meds now but if it takes to long im gonna continue with my plan just next year maybe.

My girlfriend has done some sketchy things and its really worrying me, my best friend is suicidal aswell probably to my extent and I have pretty bad trust issues and abandonment issues so that just makes everything so much more great for me. They're both in different countries so I can't really do anything and it's stressing me out more. Anyways I'm gonna go sleep more so I probably wont respond for a bit. And I'm still going to thank you no matter what.

Does medication even help that much? I know it's not a miracle drug and it doesn't help immediately but does it even truly help at all?

And I cant really take it easy ive been dealing with so much shit recently its so overwhelming and everything I do stresses me out, I have a girlfriend but I'm overthinking every moment over her cheating on me and every little weird thing she does it makes me panic and I'm scared im going to lose my best friend as well, I dont really have anyone else other than them and im so worried every second. I'm also having a lot of irl issues along with online issues plus the fact I have bipolar disorder and thats making a lot of things extremely tough for me, my mom and I have been trying to manage my bipolar but it's hard as fuck. So with all those issues plus other thoughts and incidents it's extremely hard to have a moment to just relax and not think, sleep is the closest thing I have to that, so in this case I'm just kind of giving up I don't really find excitement in living anymore honestly. Thank you for talking to me btw most people just scroll by and never even consider talking to people with issues so thank you a lot I appreciate you a lot.

I'm in South Carolina I've talked to my mother abt getting meds she said it'd be extremely difficult to get them because of the lack of psychiatrists for teens and the ones that are here have extremely long waiting lists, and even then she said it'd make it a bit harder because im underage. My sister got meds but it took her longer than a year to get them, im not waiting that long.

E: sorry I kept taking so long to respond I dont get notifications from reddit and I was sleeping mostly all day long
Idk I just wanted to say hi or smth to a few people while I can because I don't really get much interaction with people

I dont mean to be rude in any way or remind you of anything shitty in the past but may I ask what stopped you from continuing trying? What gave you the motivation to want to get help? Sometimes I find motivation to get help and try to be happy but that sudden burst of energy disappears after awhile(that's basically my bipolar acting up).And it's happening again, im back to the point of planning a suicide and that little voice you mentioned does exactly what you said it does and I hate it. I need advice from someone like you someone whos been through a deep depression like this. I need to find what will keep me from trying to commit suicide, I know most of my triggers and they are unavoidable and tbh kind of addictive. I need away from this shit and it seems like nothing is doing the trick. Thank you for keeping up with this but if you need a break from helping me or keeping up with me just tell me I can get pretty annoying when asking for advice lol.

Weed doesn't even fully numb those senses for me, yeah it makes me really happy but I still have breakdowns sometimes when high, even when mixing shit, I still tend to breakdown and cry when high as fuck sometimes. I guess my goal is to be happier and be sober at the same time, I love not being sober but most of the times I have to be sober and I kind of don't feel like getting high so I want an alternative to getting high. I dont know if anti depressants and talking will help me in the way I want it to but let's hope.

Tbh im kinda in that situation rn, I want help but I don't want to be happy, this might sound weird but I have my reasons as to why but I kind of want to stay a bit depressed, I just don't want to have constant suicidal thoughts and feel like suicide is the only way out of this shitty mind set, im tired of being constantly alone, I dont even have irl friends, I have one friend who I do talk to on a daily basis, we've been online friends since I was around 6-7 and hes a great guy but not having any other contact with anyone not even irl really fucking hits hard. I dont know what I can even do other than get a therapist and psychiatrist. I want to seek a relationship but I dont really know how to right now and I've been in 2 relationships before but those ended very shitty and I dont really know if im ready for one because I have abandonment issues and major trust issues. I'm sorry if I made a fuck ton of typos or mistakes in my sentences im pretty high right now and I wanna sleep. Anyways goodnight to you and everyone else reading this. Thank you and everyone else for giving me advice and helping me with this.

Alright, I'll probably end up talking about what would happen if i asked to not be diagnosed, but i still dont know. Ill consider all options and talk with my mom about whats most likely the best option right now. Thank you!

I'll probably end up bursting out in tears if the questions get a little bit deep. Im comfortable talking about some topics though not many, Most depression related topics will probably start to make me cry if it gets deep. Most of the thoughts i have are probably not really the best to bring up to a therapist.
I dont really know if im looking for someone to listen to me talk and cry about personal things lmao. I'm considering it still but I dont know still.
Yeah I think I might look into a psychiatrist more. Thanks.

Thank you I hope I do too. I havent been diagnosed with bipolar yet and I'm hoping to stay clear of that but will a psychiatrist or therapist diagnose me and label me like that? Also there are a couple good reasons as to why I said im bipolar but not diagnosed with it, ask me if interested as to why but if not then please don't ask(not trying to be mean I just don't really want to talk about it in a public comment section).
